query: WITH target_lessons AS (SELECT id, title, content, is_active, updated_at FROM lessons WHERE id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae')) SELECT 'lesson' AS resource_type, l.id::text AS resource_id, l.title, l.is_active, NULL::boolean AS is_published, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) AS content_length, l.updated_at, 0 AS question_count FROM target_lessons l UNION ALL SELECT 'exercise' AS resource_type, e.id::text AS resource_id, e.title, e.is_active, e.is_published, length(coalesce(e.content_markdown, '') || coalesce(e.correction_markdown, '') || coalesce(e.statement, '')) AS content_length, e.updated_at, count(q.id)::integer AS question_count FROM exercises e LEFT JOIN exercise_questions q ON q.exercise_id = e.id WHERE e.lesson_id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') GROUP BY e.id, e.title, e.is_active, e.is_published, e.content_markdown, e.correction_markdown, e.statement, e.updated_at UNION ALL SELECT 'quiz' AS resource_type, qz.id::text AS resource_id, qz.title, qz.is_active, qz.is_published, length(coalesce(qz.description, '')) AS content_length, qz.updated_at, count(qq.id)::integer AS question_count FROM quizzes qz LEFT JOIN quiz_questions qq ON qq.quiz_id = qz.id WHERE qz.lesson_id IN ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750', 'dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') GROUP BY qz.id, qz.title, qz.is_active, qz.is_published, qz.description, qz.updated_at ORDER BY resource_type, title LIMIT 100;
